name: Tengoku Hime ~Shinsei Tairan Soukai no Hasha-tachi~
original_name: 天極姫 ～新世大乱・双界の覇者達～
source:
A crossover work featuring heroines from Gesen18’s previous games Sengokuhime (set in the Sengoku period) and Sangokuhime (based on the Romance of the Three Kingdoms).

The main change is that the battle system is now real-time. As a result, you’ll have to note the movement speed of armies, in addition to their attack powers. This allows more strategies to be implemented by the player on the battlefield.

[From [url=https://omochikaeri.wordpress.com/2014/09/01/september-2014-eroge-releases/]Hau~ Omochikaeri![/url]]
translation:
以Gesen18之前的游戏《战国姬》（以战国时代为背景）和《三国姬》（基于三国演义）中的女主角的联动作品。

主要的变化是战斗系统现在是实时的。因此，除了攻击力之外，你还必须注意军队的移动速度。这使得玩家可以在战场上实施更多的策略。

[来自[url=https://omochikaeri.wordpress.com/2014/09/01/september-2014-eroge-releases/]Hau~ Omochikaeri！[/url]]
